svg.title: Known-best packing of 295 unit squares
svg.desc: The retained known-best n=295 construction, normalized to Witness/v2 and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer.

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: retained numerical center/angle subpacking for n=295 from the catalogue's n=296 construction. The source metadata supplies attribution and provenance; the upstream SVG is not retained because no express redistribution terms were located. This conservative retention policy is not a legal conclusion. The replayed finite-precision numerical check establishes only tolerance-bounded feasibility of these retained facts, not exact geometry, an exact certificate, or optimality.
